# Meeting in the Tavern

"Where have you been?" Lyra asked, her eyes narrowing as she set her mug down.

"Getting the map," Thorne replied. He sat opposite her, sighing deeply. "It wasn't easy."

"Did anyone follow you?"

"No," Thorne said, leaning closer. "I made sure of it. But we don't have much time."

Lyra leaned back. "We never do. When do we leave?"

"Midnight. At the southern gate."

"I'll be there," she said, nodding.
